description: Minimal Codex-native hooks for safety, session context, and path-only journaling.

hooks.command: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from'node:fs';import path from'node:path';import{pathToFileURL}from'node:url';let d=process.cwd(),h='';for(;;){const f=path.join(d,'.codex','hooks','hook.mjs');if(fs.existsSync(path.join(d,'.codex','hooks.json'))&&fs.existsSync(path.join(d,'AGENTS.md'))&&fs.existsSync(f)&&!fs.lstatSync(f).isSymbolicLink())h=f;const p=path.dirname(d);if(p===d)break;d=p}if(!h)process.exit(1);await (await import(pathToFileURL(h).href)).runHook()"
